## Verdict
needs-revision

## Concerns
- **claim-3:** Artifact ce9dca58d3924029b4839d830f43cfe6514239f9a1025dc2f51a2e1c9bb3fedb uses only one custom Smith-normal-form implementation. Neither a second exact implementation nor rational-rank plus unimodular-maximal-minor certificates independently reproduce the 90 SNF outputs.
- **claim-4:** The finite irredundance conclusions depend on the uncorroborated SNF computations in claim-3, so they remain unsupported.
- The LR relation coefficients are independently checked against horizontal Pieri, and the right-to-left tableau order is implemented. The two requested zero regressions are also correctly justified by Pieri.
- The reduction to \(h_k s_\mu\) relations is asserted in the draft but not established within the retained computation evidence. A concise proof that \(A_+=(h_1,\ldots,h_q)\) in \(\Lambda/I_{r,q}\) should accompany the computation.
- The attempt is bounded to 90 rectangular instances; it does not prove a general statement or identify those instances with all admissible permutation parameters.
